t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I need to try remember which forest the most mushrooms are in so that I can get the most mushrooms I can. I only have a short time to select which gnome so I need to keep my concentration.

vb_textbox.text: Make sure you remember which gnome took you to the forest with the most mushrooms and then make sure you click on the gnome in the same colour sequence (such as the orange, green, red and blue gnome leads you to the bright forest and the brown, pink, yellow and purple lead you to the dark forest). So try to remember which gnome you clicked on so that you can be led to that forest again.But then the amount of mushrooms change in the forests so you have to work that out again. But once you get into it it is quite fun actually. Ignore the shape and size of the gnome's hats though, they don't mean anything.
